scripts.dev: vite build && node scripts/write-asset-refs.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev --test-scheduled
scripts.deploy: vite build && node scripts/write-asset-refs.mjs && node scripts/upload-assets.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Optional. Leave blank — open /admin after deploy; a token is generated and shown once to copy. Or paste your own password here.
